whyMatters.en: Agoura Hills six-piece that made rap-rock/nu-metal the default millennial rock radio format via Hybrid Theory (2000).
whyMatters.zh: 阿古拉山六人组：借 Hybrid Theory（2000）把 rap-rock/nu-metal 做成千禧一代摇滚电台默认格式。

shortBio.en: Chester Bennington / Mike Shinoda dual-vocal nu-metal; In the End is the global hook.
shortBio.zh: Chester Bennington / Mike Shinoda 双人声 nu-metal；In the End 是全球钩子。

body.en:
Formed 1996 (earlier name Xero). Hybrid Theory and Meteora fused DJ/sample beds, downtuned guitars, Shinoda’s rap verses, Bennington’s melodic chorus.

In the End (2000) is the structural template taught to a decade of bands. Later catalogs add electronic and concept-album turns; the chronicle weight is how 2000–03 rock radio sounded in malls and MTV.
body.zh:
1996 年组建（曾用名 Xero）。Hybrid Theory 与 Meteora 融合 DJ/采样铺底、降调吉他、Shinoda 的 rap 主歌、Bennington 的旋律副歌。

In the End（2000）是教给整整十年乐队的结构模板。后期目录加入电子与概念专集转向；编年分量是 2000–03 商场与 MTV 上的摇滚电台声景。
